title: Preserve the independent residual-noise qualification
statement: For matched pair memories at positive logical density and fixed whole accuracy, residual INDEPENDENT dephasing exposure must scale O(1/n); the source supplies a converse order and an explicit pair construction with small constants. In the reported1024-spin128-logical case at gamma T=1, ideal routing error changes from1.94e-31 at perfect correlation to.0254355930986051 at correlation .9999. This is an exact-noise-versus-coefficient-uncertainty comparison, not a gate/hardware-error budget or a generic correlated-noise theorem.
